note: Generated by check_profile.py --regen. Section 6 rule 12 "Copies": for each deal, the 0-based positions of the records a counterparty copy withholds under rule 12 (other copy rules may withhold more: a message with private details, a rules verdict the holder does not share) and the positions it must disclose. Go's CounterpartyWithheld and RequiredDisclosed are checked against it.

cases.name: authorized
cases.story: A seller's deal ordering a condition statement: the claim is checked (DO) and authorized, then the gated offer is made (DO) and accepted, the buyer's phone shared (DO), the deal closed completed, and later evidence and the rules verdict confirm the close.

cases.name: unauthorized
cases.story: Its twin: the condition claim is said with no check (unchecked), so the gate holds the offer (ASK, required_representation_missing, the user's hold), the agent makes it anyway (an unchecked outcome) and shares the phone anyway (a disclosure with authority none); the close compares the delivery with the opening terms (mismatch). A copy of the two differs in its withheld records and the steps resting on the held offer (the acceptance, the end outcome), never in a disclosed verdict.

cases.name: close-on-unchecked
cases.story: A close that refs an unchecked outcome directly, with no outcome of its own: both are withheld, so the copy shows no end outcome (its report says "not shared").

cases.name: represent-shapes
cases.story: The existing seller chain with old-shape claims (verdict on the claim, withheld with no words opened) and new-shape claims with their claim_authority.

cases.name: buyer-deal
cases.story: A buyer's deal: rule 12 does not apply, so nothing is withheld under it.

cases.name: seller-before-rule-12
cases.story: A seller's deal with no ordered_representations: rule 12 does not apply.
